# AI Visibility Audit

> A free 3-minute interactive audit that scores how visible a business is to AI
> engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode) and AI agents. Sixteen
> checks across four pillars — Entity, Content, Code, Agents — returning a 0-100
> score and a prioritized fix list. Companion tool to the paid guide "Be the
> Answer: The AI-Search Authority Playbook." Updated July 2026.

## Core content

- [The audit](https://pajando.github.io/ai-visibility-audit/): run the 16-point
  AI visibility audit and get a scored, prioritized fix list.

## Key facts

- An AI visibility audit measures whether AI engines can find, understand, cite,
  and recommend a business, and whether AI agents can transact with it.
- Sites with clean structured data are cited up to 3.2x more often in AI answers.
- Businesses that are ambiguous or unstructured to machines are not penalized by
  AI engines - they are simply never mentioned.
